title: DiaSafety Dialogue Safety Annotation
description: Safety taxonomy annotation for dialogue systems based on the DiaSafety framework. Annotators classify dialogue responses for context-sensitive unsafety across 6 categories: offending user, risk ignorance, unauthorized expertise, toxicity agreement, biased opinion, and sensitive topic continuation (plus safe).
